summary: This video reviews the top-performing team compositions and hero builds from Week 1 of the Continental Challenge on Chinese servers in Season 9. The creator breaks down the #1 player's 4.5 billion damage runs featuring Dauntless and Aura teams, as well as high-ranking Corrosion, Shadow, and Ice Blast setups. Key gear recommendations include stacking 3-piece Dragonflame set bonuses across team members for a 24% total team damage boost. Detailed stat priorities and artifact setups are examined for key damage dealers and supports like Guinavivre, Nastjenka, Child of Chaos, and Rook.

heroes.name: Guinavivre
heroes.note: Built for Attack, Crit Rate, Crit Damage, and Attack Speed while wearing the Dragonflame set.

heroes.note: Built with Attack Speed, Attack, Accuracy, and Skill Haste.

heroes.name: Selva
heroes.note: Enables 3-piece Dragonflame set stacking across the team.

heroes.name: Child of Chaos
heroes.verdict: Core support in Aura, Corrosion, and Shadow teams

heroes.name: Rook

heroes.name: Saverio

meta_changes: Aura and Dauntless remain top-tier meta choices for Continental Challenge bosses.
Dragonflame gear set stacking on multiple heroes provides significant multiplicative team damage buffs.
tips: Equip 3-piece Dragonflame sets on three separate heroes in your team to stack an 8% damage boost up to 3 times for a 24% total team damage increase.
When building Child of Chaos, either bring high Accuracy or select the healing talent to bypass Accuracy requirements completely.
